name: Immune complex capsule or tablet
identity: One-a-day tablet with high-dose vitamin C, zinc, selenium and vitamin D sold for the immune system; the dose is one tablet.
rule: Per 100 g of the product, each value is the median of the labels below that declare it, and a value enters only when at least three declare it; a label states its nutrients per dose, so the file converts them with the dose's weight (the pack's net content divided by its count of tablets, capsules, sticks or drops, or the stated dose weight). Salt becomes sodium (salt in g × 400 = sodium in mg). Fewer than three labels declare energy, so the row stands at 0 kcal under the verification policy's clause for label generics with a micronutrient. Nothing a label leaves out becomes zero. Labels read on 2026-10-30 from dm.de, rossmann.de and shop-apotheke.com product pages.
